_meanings:
.²1 A pinnacle, turret, projection (on columns or gates); {#anekaviDaprAsAdaharmyavalaBIniryUhaSatasaMkulam#}
 ({#apaSyat#}) <ls>Mb. 1. 3. 133</ls>; {#vitardiniryUhaviwaNkanIqaH#} <ls>Śi. 3. 55</ls>.
 (where Mālli. renders {#niryUha#} by {#mattavAraRAKya apASrayaH#} and
 quotes Vaijayantī; perhaps it was so called from its resemblance to the
 shape of an elephant in rut); {#cArutoraRaniryUhA#} <ls>Rām.</ls>
.²2 A chaplet, crest, head-ornament; {#badDABaraRaniryUhAH#} <ls>Mb. 5. 155. 12</ls>.
.²3 A peg projecting from a wall.
.²4 Wood placed in a wall for pigeons to build their nests or to perch
 upon; <ls>Śi. 3. 55</ls>.
.²5 A door, gate.
.²6 Extract, decoction.
